technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage Spring Batch and Spring XD Job Execution APIs to aggregate progress metrics across nested job executions for U1.
Extend Spring XD REST endpoints and job orchestration service to allow restarting composed job executions from the last failed state for U2.
Conduct investigation spikes (U3, U4) focusing on API compatibility with Kafka 0.9 binder and Lattice deployment infrastructure, producing architectural decision records.
Enhance the Spring Cloud Stream payload expression parser to handle dot-delimited property paths for nested JSON and Tuple objects for U5.
Utilize Spring Shell's completion mechanism to provide dynamic auto-completion for registered module names and their respective configuration options for U6.
Implement a dedicated Spring Cloud Data Flow (s-c-d) Deployer SPI targeted at Apache Mesos and Marathon/Chronos APIs for U7.
Extract shared Redis JUnit test rules and fixtures into an independent artifact and repository for reusability across s-c-d projects for U8.
assumptions: Development environment includes access to Java 17+, local or test instances of Kafka 0.9, Mesos, Lattice, and Redis.
The developer is familiar with the Spring Framework, Spring Batch, Spring Cloud Data Flow, and Spring Cloud Stream codebases.
Spike activities (U3, U4) will deliver technical evaluation documents and proof-of-concept code rather than production-grade features.
Existing Spring XD and s-c-d test frameworks are available for writing unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_description: Analyze technical requirements across all user stories (U1-U8), design domain model extensions, and prepare local build environments.
Develop backend logic to aggregate execution progress across child jobs in a composed job and update the Spring XD UI component.
Implement REST API endpoints and state management service logic to support restarting existing failed/stopped composed jobs.
Investigate Kafka 0.9 client API changes, test compatibility with spring-cloud-stream binders, and identify required improvements.
Explore Lattice setup options for s-c-d bare metal deployment, evaluate container orchestration capabilities, and document bootstrap steps.

activities.activity_name: U5: Dot-Delimited Syntax for Tuple and JSON
activities.activity_description: Implement dot-delimited property path resolution in spring-cloud-stream expression parser for Tuple and JSON payloads along with unit tests.

activities.activity_name: U6: Shell Tab Completion for Modules
activities.activity_description: Integrate dynamic tab completion logic into the s-c-d shell using Spring Shell APIs to auto-complete module names and options.
Implement the s-c-d Deployer SPI for Apache Mesos/Marathon, allowing app launching, status monitoring, and lifecycle management on Mesos.
Create a new repository, move the Redis JUnit @Rule and test helpers into it, publish the artifact, and update s-c-d build dependencies.
Perform end-to-end testing across delivered increments, update user guides/release notes, and verify build pipelines.
